proves.claim: a shout with glued prose is refused, and hashes, URLs and quoted examples are not prose.

shouts.main.a-shout-with-glued-prose-is-.why: Keeps the shouts cell's main behaviour from regressing unseen.

proves.claim: watch flags become filters, and every bad value is refused with a usage error before anything is followed.

shouts.main.watch-flags-become-filters-a.why: Keeps the shouts cell's main behaviour from regressing unseen.

proves.claim: watchStart reads the board id, its seats and its latest event sequence from the file alone.

shouts.main.watchstart-reads-the-board-i.why: Keeps the shouts cell's main behaviour from regressing unseen.

proves.claim: following prints one line per event in order, skips change pings, and follows a dropped stream from the last sequence.

shouts.main.following-prints-one-line-pe.why: Keeps the shouts cell's main behaviour from regressing unseen.

proves.claim: filters keep only the wanted kinds, item and audience, and --json prints one versioned document per line.

shouts.main.filters-keep-only-the-wanted.why: Keeps the shouts cell's main behaviour from regressing unseen.

proves.claim: every shouts test file that reads files carries an input header naming the cells it reads.

shouts.inputs.readers-declare.why: A reader with no header hides what its result depends on.

proves.claim: no shouts test declares the whole source tree, and every declared cell is one it can read.

shouts.inputs.no-whole-tree.why: A whole-tree header would make every change rerun the test.

proves.claim: every shouts-cell test registered here has a stable ID and one complete record, and an unregistered test is reported and fails only with tests.registryStrict on.

shouts.registry.complete.why: Without a record per test a test can be deleted or duplicated with no one noticing what it proved.
